summary: v18 'Günlük Ürün Satışları' dashboard section frontend testing complete on mobile viewport 390x844. All acceptance criteria verified: (1) login with cakmak.ebubekir29@gmail.com / 1234567 → dashboard renders with 'HOŞ GELDINIZ' greeting and 'Açık Masalar' section. (2) Section 'Günlük Ürün Satışları' (testID=daily-product-sales) is present, shows date 19.09.2026 (container date=today) and correctly renders the empty state 'Bu tarihte ürün satışı yok' for today · Merkez. (3) Opened filter modal via the funnel button (top-right header), changed both Başlangıç and Bitiş text-inputs to 26/08/2026, tapped Uygula → filter banner reads '26/08 - 26/08' and section header updates to '1 adet · 1 ürün · ₺2,00' with rank-1 row 'Abdul Rızaoğlu · 1 farklı saatte · Merkez · 1 adet · ₺2,00' (bar filled ~100%). (4) daily-product-search input filters correctly: typing 'abdul' shows '1 ürün bulundu' and keeps the row; typing 'xyz-no-match' shows '0 ürün bulundu' + empty-state 'Aramayla eşleşen ürün yok'. (5) Tapping daily-product-sort-tutar then daily-product-sort-adet highlights the correct segment (primary bg + white text) with no crash or re-fetch. (6) Regression OK: 'Günlük Satılan Fişler' renders immediately below with its own search box and 1 fiş row; 'Aylık Karşılaştırma' (Eylül vs Ağustos) and 'Son 6 Ay Satış Trendi' cards render above. No console errors (only ignored shadow*/expo-notifications/pointerEvents deprecation warnings). No pageerrors. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the tested component.
critical_code_review_comments: DailyProductSalesSection.tsx (~236 lines) is well-scoped, uses async/await + AbortController-free but has correct `iptal` flag cleanup for the useEffect fetch — no leaked setState on unmount.
Component uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and Bearer token from useAuthStore — matches project convention.
All interactive elements have testIDs: daily-product-sales (wrapper), daily-product-search (TextInput), daily-product-sort-adet, daily-product-sort-tutar, daily-product-more.
Touch targets meet 44px minimum (minHeight:44 on search wrapper, sort buttons, and 'Daha fazla göster').
All text is wrapped in <Text>. Styles applied inline (not StyleSheet.create) but consistent with dashboard.tsx pattern — no violation.
No MongoDB _id concerns (MySQL project). No mocked APIs.
